about_title: A community keeping its story together
about_intro: Sambahamphe Utthan Sangh brings together the Sambahamphe families of the Limbu (Yakthung) people, in Nepal and abroad, to preserve our history, keep our family line and pass our culture to the next generation.
about_dance_alt: Illustration of chyabrung drummers and dancers in traditional dress
about_work_family_body: Record every generation of the Sambahamphe line, checked by genealogy editors before it is published.
about_work_history_body: Collect oral histories, documents and photographs before they are lost.
about_work_culture_body: Chasok Tangnam, the chyabrung and the Mundhum, passed on through gatherings and teaching.
about_work_support_body: Welfare work and a network for members in Nepal and abroad.
about_seal_alt: The seal of Sambahamphe Utthan Sangh
about_seal_intro: The seal carries the Sangh's name in Devanagari and in the Sirijanga script of the Limbu language, around three symbols:
about_seal_mountain_body: The Himalaya of the eastern hills, the land our ancestors came from.
about_seal_silam_body: The woven diamond of Yakthung culture, framing what we protect.
about_seal_diyo_body: A lamp kept burning: knowledge handed from one generation to the next.
about_seal_year: The year at its foot, २०५२, is the year the Sangh was founded.
about_lead_body: The central board, the regional boards and the gaau committees are elected by the general assembly.
boards_intro: The Sangh is run by elected boards. The general assembly elects the central board; regional boards and gaau committees look after their own areas.
